Ana (docs): Quick heads-up — I'm starting a scoped migration to replace the phrase `model family` -> `model suite` across our docs and SDK examples. Found ~120 hits in markdown and code snippets. Opening PRs in small batches. Any constraints I should know about?

Mike (eng-ml): Make sure we don't accidentally rename runtime config keys or API fields in code samples. Those must stay exact.

Jia (devex): Can you paste the full list + proposed mapping? I can run the lexicon checks and a link-fix pass.

lexicon-bot: scan results: scanned 118 instances of "model family" under docs/ and samples/; suggested replacement: "model suite". Notes: 6 occurrences inside API reference (field names), 3 in legal text, 4 in external linked content. Flagged items require manual review.

Ana (docs): PR opened for first batch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/542 — changes are only in prose and SDK snippets (JS/Python examples). Example snippet updated:
```
// before
const res = await client.generate({ modelFamily: 'redwood-1' })
// after (docs wording only)
const res = await client.generate({ model_family: 'redwood-1' }) // note: runtime key unchanged in API
```

Samira (product): We should not change any user-facing UI copy or admin-console labels without PM sign-off. Add a glossary entry for "model suite" that explains mapping to existing UI term "model family".

Evan (engineering): Plan suggestion: 4 small PRs, run `scripts/validate-terminology.sh` and our examples smoke tests before merging. If `validate-terminology.sh` reports API-keywords, block the PR. Example command: `./scripts/validate-terminology.sh docs/ samples/` (returns non-zero on conflicts).

Jia (devex): I'll queue lexicon-bot for a second pass once PR 542 is up. Tag me @jia and add `label:docs-review`. Also please add `no-changelog:yes` if there are no behavior changes.

Ana (docs): Action items: 1) Ana: split remaining edits into 3 more PRs by EOD. 2) Jia: run lexicon-bot and post the conflict list. 3) Mike/Evan: verify no API/runtime fields were touched in code samples. 4) Samira: draft glossary blurb and confirm UI impact. I'll append a checklist to PR 542.

Mike (eng-ml): :+1:

Ana (docs): Thanks — will post a short summary in #eng and ping integrators before merging the first PR.
